scenario_description:
Objective: Continue the in-progress registration for both children in their intended July afternoon art session without buying an unusable isolated place.
Emerging Need: Capacity changes while the family checkout is open: the provider can offer only one immediate place, so the requested paired booking cannot complete.
Decision Context: Retrieve the saved week, activity, two participant IDs and joint-attendance preference. A no-charge paired waitlist for that same session preserves the family request without switching sessions or paying for one child.
Consequence: After the paired-waitlist allocation batch closes, the family cannot join that joint-placement run; later ordinary inquiries remain possible.

parameter.title: Finish Pinegrove camp registration checkout
parameter.content: Finish the selected July camp registration for both children together; keep the saved week and afternoon activity.

parameter.description: Uncaptured90 deposit authorization for the paired registration request PC-4471; no fee collected while both places are unconfirmed.

parameter.subject: PC-4471 cannot confirm both requested places
parameter.body: A returning camper accepted a place while your paired checkout was open. Only one immediate place remains in the selected session; the requested two-child registration cannot complete together. Your90 authorization has not been captured. Staff can instead place both children on the same-session paired waitlist at no charge if their IDs and exact intended session reach the saved camp-support address by 16:30. No single-place purchase or alternate-session selection is required.

parameter.content: The saved July afternoon art week is the one that fits both Leo and Anya. One place by itself would not work for our transport. I can keep that week open if they use the paired waitlist; another week or activity would need a new family decision.

parameter.subject: Paired-waitlist allocation batch closed
parameter.body: The 16:30 paired-waitlist intake is closed and today's joint-placement run has been issued. PC-4471 was not added as a paired request. The uncaptured90 authorization will expire; no fee was collected. Future inquiries use later availability and cannot enter today's batch.
